attempted_claim: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic p >= 13 and let X be a smooth Fano threefold over k. Is X necessarily Frobenius-split (equivalently, for smooth Fano X, globally F-regular with trivial test ideal)? In particular, does there exist a smooth Fano threefold in characteristic p >= 13 that is not F-split?
decisive_failure: No smooth non-F-split Fano threefold at p >= 13 was found and no universal splitting proof was established; the bounded search covered only sparse sextics in P(1,1,1,1,3) and Fermat-diagonal members (260 exact Fedder tests plus exhaustive weight <= 10 Fermat enumeration), not the full 105-family classification, and smoothness certification used F_13 Jacobian chart counts rather than complete Groebner verification. Scripts and WORKLOG notes are retained as working evidence only.
